scope: Same revised public fixture built separately from immutable DS54 and private DS56. Product remains54; no Task/adoption/human acceptance. Geometry and keyboard checks are scoped evidence; popup container-resize remains an explicit comparative diagnostic.
fixture_revision: Supported avatar {text:АА,tone:blue} for owner and ordinary reference, with mounted-element oracle; original values and five host profiles unchanged. Existing outer wrappers/margins/bases/box sizing are measured.
comparisons: narrow-text200 and wide-tight-text200 hold container width and font fixed while changing viewport width; they distinguish a viewport-only explanation.

wide-normal and wide-text200 hold the wide viewport and 615px container fixed while changing root font. wide-tight-text200 and wide-text200 hold root32 and viewport fixed while changing the container.
The 120px label track is measured in every profile alongside each actual font size and text extent; observations do not claim a full factorial ablation of container/font effects.

An ordinary select and date field outside .iq-properties use identical selected data and the same host width/font. They isolate the additional property-list contract without changing or overriding any DS rule.
Candidate A no-grow label versus full-width B remains a human reading question, especially the existing Поиск участника label. No B CSS is silently applied to the control.

acceptance.candidate_geometry: Complete property-list text ranges are not clipped or outside the host; no document horizontal overflow. Native input buffers and decorative initials are separate contracts; raw text/canvas/PNG evidence is preserved.
acceptance.ordinary_reference: Control and candidate preserve ordinary reference field shapes and styles relative to each row; absolute document y can change because list height changes.
acceptance.interaction: Keyboard open/cancel and selection intent count/focus identity; native one-line input. Container-only resize records old/new anchor geometry without fake window resize or layout repair.
acceptance.visual: Independent PNG review is required for full labels, value grouping, normal density, paired rhythm, pill/dot, long words and stacked no-grow label cost. A geometric pass is not human approval.

environment.text_scaling: HTML root font-size exactly 16px or 32px, not browser zoom
environment.input: Targeted keyboard/select/date/tag checks in wide-normal and wide-text200; same five profiles, no new viewport matrix
environment.load_mode: Vite compiled static preview of exact public DS imports

not_run: Actual Task or product-owned pill reflow/adoption
Backend, auth, persistence or human acceptance
True browser zoom and release Safari/Firefox/iOS/screen readers
